question: Who among the following belonged to the ancient chiefly family of the Cholas from Uraiyur, captured the Kaveri delta from the Muttaraiyar in the middle of the ninth centuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijayalaya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Vijayalaya **____**​**__

 __
 
• The mediaeval** Chola kingdom was started** by Vijayalaya Chola, who gave it a solid foundation.
 
• He was one of those kings who built up an **empire from nothing, conquered strong neighbouring empires like the Pandyas and the Pallavas,** and rose to prominence throughout all of ancient South India.
 
• The early Cholas were extremely powerful, but they gradually lost it and were reduced to serving as feudal lords for other kingdoms. Around 300 A.D., they entered total darkness. Cholas vanished entirely from their homeland after this time. Around 848 A.D., **a hero of Chola **descent who we now know to as the great Vijayalaya Chola restored Chola authority.
 
• The name** Parakesarivarman** was given to him. He rebuilt the** Lord's Shiva temple in Narthamalai called Vijayalaya Choleeswaram which was built by Mutharayars.**
 
• **Varagunavarman II of the Pandyas and Nandivarman III of the Pallavas** came up with a strategy to stymie the Cholas' growing influence in South India after suffering a devastating loss at the hands of Vijayalaya Chola.
 
• First, Varagunavarman II mounted an army-sized incursion into Chola territory. The Pandyan army arrived at the Kaveri River's north bank. Vijayalaya was quite elderly and unable to participate in conflicts at this point.
 
• **Aditya I,** however, one of his sons, was also a renowned Chola emperor. In our articles titled "Battle Of Sri Purambiam" and "Aditya I," we fully explain what happened when his son seized command of the army. Vijayalaya's son took over command of the army after he died of aging, probably around 871 A.D. **and he was succeeded by his son Aditya I.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Gandaraditha Chola
 
 
Around 955 CE, Gandaraditha Chola succeeded his father Parantaka I to rule the Chola kingdom. He also wrote poetry in Tamil for the Thiruvisaippa Palandu. Madurantaka Chola, commonly known as Uttama Chola, one of his children, succeeded his cousin Sundara Chola as the Chola ruler.

 
 
 

 Parantaka Chola I
 Parantaka Chola I was a Chola emperor who ruled for forty-eight years. He conquered Rajasimhan II to acquire Pandya and defeated the Rashtrakutas in the Vallala war in the Deccan before 916 CE. His reign's most successful period was characterised by rising success and affluence.
 
 

 Aditya Chola I
 The Imperial Chola Empire was founded by Aditya Chola I (c. 870/71 - c. 907 CE), the son of Vijayalaya Chola, who overthrew the Pallavas and occupied the Western Ganga Kingdom. Aditya Chola I was succeeded by his eldest son Parantaka Chola I.
